julia: heads-up: after int4 conversion of ZephyrX-13B I'm seeing a big drop in pass@1 on our codegen eval. perplexity up ~1.3x on dev harness. anyone seen token-alignment or rotary mismatch after conversion? s3 log: s3://redwood-ops/zephyrx/conv-2026-03-19.log

vincent: which conversion command did you run? tokenizer source?

julia: ```
convert_model \
  --src=hf/zephyrx-13b \
  --quant=int4 \
  --output=/mnt/models/zephyrx/conv \
  --tokenizer=sentencepiece \
  --preserve_vocab=false \
  --rotary-params=auto
```
logs snippet: `embedding matrix rows=50265, tokenizer.vocab_size=50266`

sam: 50266 vs 50265 -> off-by-one usually BOS/PAD/sentinel. if preserve_vocab=false the convert-tool may prune unused tokens. quick check: `python -c "import tokenizers,torch; print(tokenizer.get_vocab_size(), torch.load('pytorch_model.bin')['embeddings.weight'].shape)"`

julia: confirmed: tokenizer.vocab_size=50266 embedding rows=50265. Looks like a missing sentinel token (SP piece). When I rerun with --preserve_vocab=true quality recovers ~90% toward baseline :eyes:

maria: rotary scaling can amplify small misaligns. try `--rotary-mode=legacy` and also try headwise vs shared rotary params. small change in phase/scale can blow score after quant. run both configs and compare LM score.

julia: running both now. early results: preserve_vocab=true + legacy rotary -> top1 delta -0.02 (near baseline). int4 + preserve_vocab=false + auto rotary -> top1 delta -0.42. So primary culprit is vocab shift; rotary tweaks help but don't fully fix.

eval-bot: Auto eval finished: baseline perplexity=12.1, int4/preserve_vocab=false=15.8, int4/preserve_vocab=true=12.9

sam: proposed next steps: 1) add explicit tokenmap stage in conversion to map the stray sentinel back instead of pruning; 2) add a CI unit test asserting embedding_rows == tokenizer.vocab_size; 3) run quantization with deterministic rounding seed and compare; 4) run headwise-rotary ablation for transparency. I'll pick up the tokenmap patch.

julia: thanks — filing a follow-up PR with the failing eval and attaching the convert logs. I'll also run the headwise rotary ablation and paste results here when ready. :thumbsup:
